collection.name: Databases
collection.description: In-memory caches, relational SQL engines and key-value datastores
collection.author: Midnight Team

shard.name: MariaDB
shard.description: High-performance community-developed relational database management system, compatible drop-in replacement for MySQL.
shard.author: MariaDB Foundation & Midnight Team
shard.installScript:
#!/bin/bash
# MariaDB Installation Script for Midnight Panel
set -e
apt update && apt install -y mariadb-server

cd /mnt/server
mkdir -p /mnt/server/mysql

echo "Initializing database cluster..."
mariadb-install-db --user=container --datadir=/mnt/server/mysql

echo "MariaDB installation complete!"
